groups.defect: A rejected device remains cached, allowing subsequent requests to skip limit enforcement and authenticate.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same cache entry being populated before persistence succeeds, reported at the cache logic and the error-propagation site. Populating the cache only after a successful write resolves both.

groups.defect: Non-atomic device counting and insertion allow concurrent requests to exceed the configured limit.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same count-then-write race in the same limit-check block and require the same atomic enforcement.
